name: start-loop-button
goal: Verify clicking Start triggers the loop.start RPC and the new loop ID appears in the active list

steps.description: Wait for the new loop ID to appear in the active list

success_criteria.description: A loop ID matching 'loop-' must appear in the active loops list
No uncaught JavaScript errors during the interaction
loop.start RPC must have been called

must_not_happen.description: Start button must not trigger an innovate tick directly

assertions: New loop ID appears in the active loops list after submit
loop.start RPC call observed on the wire
negative_checks: No innovate tick triggered by the Start button
